text:
Ana (Finance): Heads up — ACME flagged a huge drop in billed embed units for Mar 3–4. Their usage spike shows client-side retries and a lot of 429s; billed tokens are ~40% lower than ingress. Can eng confirm if legacy SDK batching could've suppressed billable events?
Mike W: I pulled a quick diff of ingress vs billing by request_id. Looks like requests from sdk_version=0.9.2 sometimes hit the rate limiter and then got retried client-side with the same client-side batch id. Server dedupe logic treats the retried packet as non-billable if it matches an earlier dedup key — that could explain the undercount.
Priya S: Do we have a list of affected customers/intervals? Need numbers for a credit calc.
Jo (Eng): ACME is in the set. I ran a narrower query: 
```sql
SELECT count(*) as ingress_cnt, sum(billed_tokens) as billed_tokens 
FROM ingress_events 
WHERE client_version in ('0.9.1','0.9.2','0.9.3','0.9.4')
  AND customer_id='acme'
  AND ts >= '2026-03-03T00:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-05T00:00:00Z';
```
Ingress count 1,243,701 vs billed_tokens 752,344 (tokens not events) — rough gap ~490k tokens.
Ethan: That's material. We should avoid mass credits until we confirm replay results. Is there raw-ingress replay we can use to recompute billable flags?
Jo (Eng): Yes — we can replay from raw kafka topic with idempotency turned off and a special "force-billable" mode to recompute counts. I estimate ~2 hours run and a small S3 staging job. Will need a backfill job ticket and a finance sign-off to apply any credits.
Ana (Finance): OK. Priya, can you put together a tentative credit range? If it's ~500k tokens, at our embed rate that's about $X (ballpark).
Priya S: On it. Also need list of invoiced periods and whether the customer already disputed.
Ana (Finance): ACME opened a support ticket earlier today (INC-5421) requesting an invoice review. They included SDK logs that show repeated POSTs with identical batch ids during 2026-03-03T14:00-18:00Z.
Mike W: Engineering note — affected SDK versions have a client-side retry that reuses batch ids. Fix landed in 0.9.5 to generate new ids on retry. Suggest we patch billing dedupe to prefer server-side request_id when present.
Jo (Eng): Agreed. Short-term: backfill replay with force-billable for that customer/time window. Long-term: change dedupe semantics and emit a header for idempotency.
BillingBot: New credit-request created: CR-9982 for manual review (requested_by: Ana).
Ana (Finance): Approvals needed: finance manager and VP sales for credits > $5k. Priya, estimate please.
Priya S: Preliminary estimate: missing billed tokens ~510k ±80k => estimated credit $3,800–$4,800. I will attach the calc and link to the replay ticket once Jo confirms run results.
Ethan: If replay yields higher deltas we should cap the max credit and open a follow-up. We also need to notify product + customer success about messaging.
Jo (Eng): I'll spin the backfill tomorrow 06:00 UTC to avoid peak. Will post logs here and a checksum of counts.
Ana (Finance): Thanks — action items: (1) Jo runs replay and posts exact delta + logs; (2) Priya finalizes credit estimate and files for approval; (3) Mike/Eng to ship dedupe fix in next patch and note in release notes; (4) CS drafts message to ACME explaining timeline.
Mike W: I'll prep a short changelog entry.
Priya S: Filing approval request now. Tagging @Ethan for FYI.
Ethan: Saw it, thanks. Marking this P1 for billing ops. :white_check_mark:
Ana (Finance): If anyone else sees other customers on those sdk versions, flag them — we should run a broader audit after the ACME run.
Jo (Eng): Will add a job to scan top 100 customers for similar deltas.
Ana (Finance): Great — will loop in CS once we have confirmed numbers.
